limitations.note: The agent fixed the shift direction but also changed `match` to compare the updated window rather than the pre-edge window, moving the match pulse one clock earlier than the reference.
The test compared `match` against the same window it expected in `a_tem` after the edge, so it enforced the new timing rather than checking that the original one-cycle delay was preserved.
